findings.detail: The real 4-rank torchrun entry point deadlocks during codebook initialization. Only rank 0 calls raw_module.init_codebook(), but VQLayer.init_codebook() calls distributed.broadcast() when the process group is initialized (model/layers.py:139-144). Ranks 1-3 do not enter that collective and instead reach the barrier at line 350. In addition, each rank has its own model, so a rank-0-only initialization cannot initialize the other rank codebooks as intended.
findings.reproduction: Run the normal entry point with its configured 4-GPU torchrun launcher. After rank 0 enters the broadcast in VQLayer.init_codebook, ranks 1-3 wait at train_rqvae.py:350; the collective never completes. This occurs before the first training batch and therefore prevents the trainer from running.
findings.correction: Make every rank participate in the same initialization collectives in identical order (e.g. all ranks call init_codebook using the same data, or rank 0 computes centers and explicitly broadcasts each codebook tensor while all other ranks participate). Do not place the nonzero ranks at a barrier while rank 0 is inside a broadcast.
